scope: All 328 tracked files at baseline, plus the new PostgreSQL regression: 329 individually reviewed project files. This generated report is also checked, bringing the final tracked count to 330. The report excludes its own hash to avoid recursive self-hashing.
method: Source/configuration/documentation files were read completely and traced to their consumers. Earlier complete reads in this same conversation were reused only for byte-identical files, as identified per row. Lockfiles and historical generated manifests were parsed in full and each record validated. SVG XML/source and references were checked, and PNG artwork visually inspected. Inventory/search/test passes alone were not counted as file review.
excluded: Git internals and ignored output evidence are not project source. No untracked source files, dependency installs or build trees were present. The 39 previously staged paths are covered by the prior full review; its recorded original and accepted Git blobs were verified again.

findings.problem: Generated row IDs made ON CONFLICT ineffective for security audit retries.
findings.fix: Check tenant/request/operation/phase atomically under the serialized tenant transaction; retain the first payload and keep empty-request events independent.
findings.regression: Real PostgreSQL sequential retries, key distinctions, empty request IDs and six concurrent writers with serialization retries.

findings.problem: Malformed body tenant IDs reached membership lookup and became HTTP 500 errors.
findings.fix: Validate tenant IDs before storage and return 400; document matching identifier bounds.
findings.regression: Empty, newline, NUL and 257-byte IDs with no service/database available prove rejection precedes storage.

findings.problem: HTML maxlength=120 counts UTF-16 units and prevents entry of valid 120-codepoint non-BMP descriptions.
findings.fix: Remove premature browser truncation and retain authoritative server validation.
findings.regression: Real Chromium typing: original accepts only 60 emoji, repaired template accepts 120 at desktop/mobile widths. Server regression preserves 120 and rejects 121.

local: all 329 manifest hashes match current content
both lockfiles: root manifest agreement and every registry/integrity record
historical report path/hash validation against Git objects
validation.browser: Actual invoice template form/style in isolated Chromium contexts at 1440x900 and 390x844, sequential keyboard input; no page errors or horizontal overflow. This is template/component verification, not a locally running database-backed invoice flow. All owned contexts closed.
validation.ci: Final-commit Go/race/vet/vulnerability, PostgreSQL/HTTP contract, web, site, deployment contract, preview bundle/browser/upgrade and CodeQL results are recorded on PR #101. Earlier commit success is not substituted for final acceptance.

limitations: File coverage and successful regression tests do not prove absence of all possible bugs.
No new production deployment, live AWS/DNS audit, private Next source review or release publication.
No local full builds, full test suites or dependency installations; existing GitHub Actions perform those checks.
worktrees: Reused the current checkout and created no additional copies. Only the main checkout and this application-protected task checkout remain; the application refuses removal of its primary checkout.
report_review: Generated from the verified per-file ledger; JSON parsed, exact tracked-file set/count and every content hash rechecked. No self hash is included.
